name: agent-interface-calc-capability-597492d82eae485db516fde0dcd7752c
scope: capability-only probe; no GUI/model, no package installation
command: for x in libreoffice soffice tesseract Xvfb xdotool; do if command -v "$x" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf "%s=present\n" "$x"; else printf "%s=absent\n" "$x"; fi; done; python3 -c "import importlib.util,json; print(json.dumps({k: importlib.util.find_spec(k) is not None for k in ["Xlib","PIL","mcp","vizdoom"]}))"
